text:
maya: Quick heads up — LuminaHealth's telemetry team just confirmed they want to ingest app logs as embeddings for search/risk-detection. They're projecting a 3-4x embeddings throughput starting next month.
priya: noted. Renewal with them is Q3; this expansion could be good revenue upside but also a risk if latency/quotas spike. Can we prioritize a short enablement + capacity plan? :eyes:
ethan: what does their traffic shape look like? token size, calls/sec? I asked for a sample payload from their eng team. If it's many short docs, batching will help a lot.
sam_infra: FYI infra saw a steady rise in their tokens/day over the last 2 weeks — +120% week-over-week. Alert triggered: `embedding_quota_threshold` at 80% for acct luminahealth-prod.
ops-bot: Auto-alert — customer luminahealth-prod: quota_usage=82% (embeddings), window=24h. Pager: @sam_infra @maya
maya: they sent a sample — mostly 200-600 token docs, spikes during end-of-day ingest windows. Estimate: ~1.8M embeddings/day peak vs current 450k.
ethan: ok that's helpful. Recommend: 1) short-term surge pool (dedicated burst pods) 2) enable prefix-cache + synchronous batching (batch_size 64) 3) move to int8 quant model variant for cost. I can draft a config.
priya: agree. @maya can we get a customer workshop next Tue? Need to sync with their infra/ML teams on client-side batching and backpressure.
maya: requested Tue 10am PT, they confirmed. I'll send invite. Also asked finance about pricing add-on for sustained increase.
ethan: draft config for ops:
```
model: embed-large-v1-quant
batching:
  mode: continuous
  max_batch: 64
  max_latency_ms: 40
cache:
  prefix_kv: true
  ttl_hours: 6
```
sam_infra: I'll pre-provision 2 burst nodes and a temp quota bump for 2 weeks while we monitor. Need approval from @priya for cost commit.
priya: approve provisional bump for two weeks. please track SLA impact and cost delta in the console dashboard. i'll loop in finance.
maya: thanks all — i'll capture meeting notes and share playbook updates. action items: @ethan draft config (by EOD), @sam_infra provision burst nodes (by EOD), @priya confirm add-on pricing with finance (by tomorrow). :spiral_note_pad:
ops-bot: Task created: CS-1234 LuminaHealth embeddings surge — assignees maya, ethan, sam_infra, priya. Due 2024-06-14
maya: closing thread here once we have provisioning live. ping me if anything blocks.
